description: AgroEcoMetrics processes weather observations and calculates agricultural microclimate quantities. The Bick Lab repository provides Python modules for loading, cleaning, interpolating and saving time-series data, with equations for soil and air temperature, evapotranspiration and growing degree days. Plotting routines display calculated temperatures and photoperiods. Geographic coverage and time resolution follow the input observations; the README identifies Arlington, Wisconsin data used in its own tests. The toolkit can prepare weather-dependent inputs for irrigation and agricultural production simulations. Source access is free under MIT, with public installation instructions and example workflows. It complements related crop or water-allocation models, not representing an entire farm or food network. A limitation is that the choice of empirical or physical equation and missing-data treatment needs local justification. The listed tests do not establish performance for every climate or crop. No weather dataset was downloaded or prediction evaluated.
name: AgroEcoMetrics microclimate modelling toolkit
